department: College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Institute of Public Health

deadline.value: Fall entry only. The early application deadline is January 15, 2027, and the final application deadline is April 1, 2027 (SGSR Special Program Deadlines also lists April 1).
deadline.quote: we only admit new learners in the fall of each semester. | The early application deadline is January 15th | The final application deadline is April 1st of each year

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Pharmaceutical/Biomedical Sciences; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Pharmaceutical Sciences admissions pages do not state whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: No separate College of Pharmacy PhD funding guarantee is published; SGSR states university tuition and assistantship awards are competitive, merit-based, and not guaranteed yearly.
funding.quote: Tuition and assistantship awards are competitive and merit-based, and the School/College will award only a selected number of graduate students each Academic Semester. Funding is not guaranteed yearly

entry_route.value: Applicants may hold a baccalaureate degree (3.0+ GPA in the last 60 credit hours) or a graduate degree in a related field (3.0+ cumulative GPA).
entry_route.quote: welcomes applications from students who hold a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution of higher education with an earned Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0 or better in the last 60 credit hours of undergraduate work or hold a graduate degree in a related field from an accredited institution of higher learning with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or better.

notes: Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences; requires combined GRE score of 300 and $30 non-refundable application fee.
